ensemble_profile.runtime: Three member inferences per seed; sequential loading can limit peak memory. Voting adds a small CPU reduction; no measured new model-inference timings because saved outputs are reused.

limitations: Reused epoch/rate-selected validation; exploratory, not an independent test. Cross-fitting isolates member calibration only; no ensemble calibrator is fitted. Hard vote fractions are not probability estimates. Three matching-seed ensembles are not independent datasets.

recipe.final_test_reporting: Both ensembles are predeclared supplementary comparisons against DeBERTa Base before this development analysis; do not choose inclusion based on validation or test results. Preserve the original primary individual-model comparison.
recipe.hard: One label vote per member; majority wins; three different labels resolve to neutral. Vote shares are not calibrated probabilities; no NLL/Brier/ECE reported for hard voting.
recipe.soft: Arithmetic mean of matching-seed out-of-fold calibrated member probabilities; argmax; exact ties use negative/neutral/positive order.
